item.title: (no subject)
item.description: Isn't it crazy how this game failed to live up to its own demo in every conceivable way, even graphically, and failed to meaningfully follow up on a very compelling story established there? I think it's crazy. I'd really like to know what the fuck happened between the development of Ground Zeroes and how it evolved into the retarded clusterfuck that is The Phantom Pain. Kojima wanted games to be taken seriously, he wanted to take risks and be provocative - which I think he achieve
